[A10] PUBLIC HOST-TOOL BOUNDARY DECISION AND CORRECTION ASSIGNMENT

At `7ab1c8d0ad073fbc1977c455dea89b7b318d4e52`, full source validation command 29 (`check_baremetal_only.py --check`) exits 1 with 21 findings in the new simulation runner, its tests and suite README. [Unmodified failure and partial command ledger](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/6d68faf6720e2af0cb96ab64984e7bcf77a3e758/review-evidence/517-r1/source-first-failure). The findings concern workstation child-subreaper/process-inventory operations, not a target runtime. #259 explicitly excludes removal of host development tools merely because of their workstation OS; existing #376 runner masks implement this boundary.

Decision: recognize only the exact workstation process-control references needed by #517, using the existing file-pinned literal/context masks. No whole-file exclusion, global term permission, term obfuscation, retired product path, weakening of the product-document rule, or ratchet increase. Each accepted spelling must have a real clean control and refusal controls in another path, unrelated text in the same file, and appended prohibited text on the same line. The inventory and all pre-existing policy classes/controls remain active. This is an explicit bounded addition of the checker artifact to #517 scope; acceptance remains unchanged.

A179 Codex takes this correction in the same isolated source lane; R245 internal Codex and R246 external Opus remain reviewers. Keep every benchmarked runner/test/Makefile/harness byte unchanged if possible; the correction belongs to the policy checker and its selftests. Report any need to change execution behavior before proceeding. Original benchmarks retain their original head and remain factual, not relabelled. Full native source validation of the now-superseded head is stopped to avoid wasted repetition; it is partial, not PASS. The static bank may finish to expose other findings, but its results retain the old head and cannot clear the corrected source. A complete new source bar follows the correction, before publication or review.
